name: cp-continuity
description: Selective continuity protection with session-aware budgets, exact user evidence, and verified handoffs. Claude Code only; live runtime validation required.

mode.title: Continuity mode
mode.description: auto, protect, or normal. First installation starts in normal for a safe smoke test; enable auto after live checks.

fraction.title: Context trigger fraction
fraction.description: Capacity policy, not a hallucination boundary. Valid range 0.4 to 0.85.

reserveTokens.title: Minimum recovery reserve
reserveTokens.description: Extra space for output and growth before reset.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Claude model alias or full ID used for chunk summaries.

maxSummaryCalls.title: Summary calls per checkpoint
maxSummaryCalls.description: Budget limit; exceeding it blocks reset rather than dropping history.

maxConsecutiveHandoffs.title: Consecutive automatic handoffs
maxConsecutiveHandoffs.description: Pause after this many handoffs without a new user prompt.

registryPath.title: Optional model registry
registryPath.description: Absolute path to verified API metadata. Used only when runtime window is unavailable.

registryMaxAgeDays.title: Registry freshness days
registryMaxAgeDays.description: Maximum age of the optional model registry before it is ignored.
